race.description: Pelican Waters Resort Up To 2 Wins Pace
race.comment: PICCOLO DIAVOLO (5) has been racing well here of late. Has finished second in both appearances since coming from the back row to win over this distance. Big chance. PERFECT LOU (2) scored here last month and could be close to another success after coming from this barrier for second last week. Right in this. CALL KELLY (6) hasn't been too far away of late and should be reaching peak fitness now. Draws wide but is in the mix following a fourth at her most recent appearance here. FRENCH BUBBLES (7) improved to place last start and could progress further third up.
